summary.text: Use ICA’s change of address e-Service with Singpass. Your update is sent to participating government organisations.

details.heading: Updates are shared
details.body: Your address update will be sent automatically to all participating government organisations.

details.heading: If you do not have an IC
details.body: Write to MOH for advice about updating your address.

steps.name: Open the ICA service
steps.text: Access the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority of Singapore’s change of address e-Service using your Singpass.

steps.name: Update your address
steps.text: Update your residential address in the service.

example_phrasings: How can I inform if there is a change in my address?
How do I update my address?
Where can I report a new address?

sources.page_title: How can I inform if there is a change in my address?

quotes.text: You may update your residential address by accessing the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority of Singapore’s (ICA) change of address e-Service (https://go.gov.sg/ic-address) using your Singpass.
Any updates will automatically be transmitted to all participating government organisations via the One-Stop Change of Address Reporting Service (OSCARS).
If you do not hold an identity card but wish to update your address, please write to us (medishieldlife.sg/writetous) and we will further advise you on your request.
